Body Measurements — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Height, weight, sex and waist/hip with BMI (and its WHO category), body surface area, ideal body weight and waist-to-hip ratio.

Open in Builder

Scoring

Calculated values only; each result stays empty until all of its inputs are answered.

Questions

  1. Height (cm)
  2. Weight (kg)
  3. Sex assigned at birth (used by the ideal body weight formula)
    • Female
    • Male
  4. Waist circumference (cm)
  5. Hip circumference (cm)

Calculated results

  • Body mass index (kg/m²)
  • BMI category (WHO)
  • Body surface area (m², Mosteller)
  • Ideal body weight (kg, Devine)
  • Waist-to-hip ratio

Source and license

Source: Quetelet index (weight kg ÷ height m²); WHO adult BMI classification; Mosteller 1987, N Engl J Med 317:1098; Devine 1974, Drug Intell Clin Pharm 8:650; WHO Expert Consultation 2008, Waist circumference and waist–hip ratio (Geneva). Codes: LOINC.

License: Original wording written for this builder; covered by the project license (non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use needs written permission). Formulas are published methods; see the source. (link)

Provided to save authoring effort, not as medical advice — confirm the scale and its cut-offs for your use case.

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “Body Measurements”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
